cohort: Ninety-four pregnant women who had a history of COVID-19 infection in their current pregnancy or in the past, had been vaccinated against the Sars-CoV-2 virus, and had a platelet count of less than 100,000/mL.
finding: Hemoglobin level, history of COVID-19 infection, and current COVID-19 infection were identified as significant predictors of survival in pregnant women with moderate to severe thrombocytopenia.
